articles.title: I built a debt snowball vs avalanche calculator in 3 KB of vanilla JS (and its default example shows no difference)
articles.excerpt: I wanted a debt payoff calculator that loads instantly, needs no signup and sends nothing to a server. The result is one HTML file, about 3 KB, hosted free on GitHub Pages: Live: https://elaysuu.githu…
articles.body: I wanted a debt payoff calculator that loads instantly, needs no signup and sends nothing to a server. The result is one HTML file, about 3 KB, hosted free on GitHub Pages: Live: https://elaysuu.github.io/debt-snowball-calculator/ Source: https://github.com/elaysuu/debt-snowball-calculator This post walks through the simulation loop, plus one thing that surprised me when I tested it. The two strategies Snowball: pay minimums on everything, put every extra dollar on the smallest balance first. Avalanche: same, but put the extra on the highest APR first. When a debt is paid off, its minimum "rolls" into the next one in line. So the whole thing is: a fixed monthly budget, an ordering rule, and a loop. The simulation, month by month The core is a single function.
articles.author: Elay osetrov

articles.title: Know What's in a CSV Before You Touch It: A One-File Profiler
articles.excerpt: You get a CSV export. Before cleaning, importing or charting it, you want answers to boring questions. Which columns are mostly empty? Are there duplicate rows? Is that price of 2000 among values near…
articles.body: You get a CSV export. Before cleaning, importing or charting it, you want answers to boring questions. Which columns are mostly empty? Are there duplicate rows? Is that price of 2000 among values near 100 a typo? Opening it in a spreadsheet works for small files, but it is slow to repeat and hard to share. I wrote a Hermes skill, csv-quick-insights , built around one Python file that uses only the standard library. No pandas, no install, no API key. It auto-detects the delimiter, infers a type for each column (integer, float, date, boolean, category, text), counts missing values, flags duplicate rows and ragged lines, and marks numeric outliers with the 1.5 x IQR rule.

articles.title: One Slow LLM Provider Shouldn't Starve Your Login Route: Bulkheads in 60 Lines of Node
articles.excerpt: Book: System Design Pocket Guide: Fundamentals Also by me: Thinking in Go (2-book series) — Complete Guide to Go Programming + Hexagonal Architecture in Go My project: Hermes IDE | GitHub — an IDE for…
articles.body: Book: System Design Pocket Guide: Fundamentals Also by me: Thinking in Go (2-book series) — Complete Guide to Go Programming + Hexagonal Architecture in Go My project: Hermes IDE | GitHub — an IDE for developers who ship with Claude Code and other AI coding tools Me: xgabriel.com | GitHub Your LLM provider has a bad afternoon. Completions that took 2 seconds now take 30. Nothing errors and nothing returns a 500; the calls just sit there. Ten minutes later your on-call channel lights up with "nobody can log in." The login route never calls the LLM, but it is waiting in the same line as every chat request, and that line stopped moving. The fix has a name older than your stack: the bulkhead. You split your capacity into compartments so a flood in one stays in one.

articles.title: What Nobody Warns You About When Two Companies Merge Their Identity and File Systems
articles.excerpt: The announcement goes out, a joint call happens, and for a few weeks the work is mostly announcements and calendars. Then somebody asks a genuinely hard question: which login does the finance team use…
articles.body: The announcement goes out, a joint call happens, and for a few weeks the work is mostly announcements and calendars. Then somebody asks a genuinely hard question: which login does the finance team use now. I’ve been through a couple of these, and the pattern is fairly consistent. The visible parts of a merge get planned carefully. The long tail of accounts, folders, and odd little permissions tends to arrive later, and it keeps arriving for about a year. Nobody is being careless. It is simply that merging two environments means reconciling two sets of decisions made by different people, at different times, under different pressures. Those decisions rarely document their own reasoning. What I’ve noticed is that the technical migration usually finishes well before the social one.

articles.title: How to Implement Security Headers That Actually Matter in 2026
articles.excerpt: How to Implement Security Headers That Actually Matter in 2026 Security headers have been on every web security checklist for years, yet a quick scan of production traffic shows most applications stil…
articles.body: How to Implement Security Headers That Actually Matter in 2026 Security headers have been on every web security checklist for years, yet a quick scan of production traffic shows most applications still ship with defaults. A missing Content-Security-Policy turns a minor XSS bug into a session theft; an absent Strict-Transport-Security leaves users exposed on the first HTTP redirect. These aren't theoretical risks — they're the path of least resistance for attackers who enumerate easy wins before going deeper. This article focuses on the headers that carry real weight, with working code you can drop into a Python or Go service today. The Short List: Headers That Move the Needle Not every security header deserves the same attention. Stripping X-Powered-By is cosmetic.
articles.author: Ayi NEDJIMI

articles.body: Cara Menggunakan Treg People Search API API pencarian orang Treg memberi agen coding Anda satu token untuk menemukan orang, email kerja mereka, dan penilaian apakah email tersebut benar-benar asli. Anda menginstal CLI treg , masuk sekali, lalu Claude Code atau Codex memanggil tool terarah seperti treg.people.search , treg.people.email.find , dan treg.people.email.verify . articles.body: Samsung’s Certified Re-Newed program has finally arrived on Amazon, bringing in 14 refurbished Galaxy phones across two generations. The list starts at $489 for the Galaxy S24 FE (128GB) and goes as high as $1,029 for the Galaxy S25 Ultra (512GB). This gives Amazon customers a wide range of older flagships to choose from. These aren’t just any kind of refurbished phones, either. Samsung uses its own 147-point quality test to ensure everything works like new before labeling them as Certified Re-Newed. It’s not just a battery replacement; Samsung adds a one-year warranty and even slaps on a new IMEI number. In other words, it’s cheaper than buying a brand-new flagship , yet safer than settling for a second-hand phone.

articles.body: TL;DR YouTube has acknowledged that some Android users are still encountering Server Error 400, despite announcing a fix on November 1. The error prevents affected users from accessing YouTube or loading videos normally. Google is working on another fix, but its suggested workarounds will delete downloaded videos. YouTube declared victory over a frustrating Android bug over the weekend, only to find itself fighting the same battle two days later. The company has walked back its all-clear on the dreaded Server Error 400, confirming that some users still can’t access the app or watch videos normally. In a fresh update to its official support thread , Google acknowledged the problem persists and that its teams are still working on a fix.

articles.excerpt: Hundreds of seemingly innocent apps reportedly turn into troubling deepfake generators after installation.
articles.body: TL;DR Researchers uncovered a network of over 400 ‘nudify’ apps and websites on the Play Store and App Store. These apps masquerade as innocent tools and reveal a hidden deepfake interface after installation. The apps were traced back to Chinese developers and Hong Kong-based KeLing Technology Limited. Apple and Google often talk about the strict guidelines that apps need to follow in order to be allowed on their stores. However, every few months, new reports emerge of harmful apps making their way onto both the Play Store and the App Store. Apps like the fake Chrome browser spotted last month are concerning enough, but Google and Apple have a much bigger, more alarming problem on their hands with “nudify” apps.

articles.body: Created by LeSean Thomas and Studio Mir, who both worked on The Legend of Korra , Bass X Machina is a reimagining of the story of Bass Reeves (Brian Tyree Henry), an escaped slave who worked in Indian Territory as a deputy U.S. Marshal. Reeves’ real life was extraordinary, and is said to have inspired the character of the Lone Ranger, but Bass X Machina also gives him a cybernetic arm that shoots magic bullets. The criminals he fights get even bigger upgrades, and the stakes can at times escalate to truly ludicrous levels. Henry does an especially great job expressing exasperation as Bass faces plenty of absurd foes, like an outlaw in a rampaging bull mech that requires complex cooperation to take down.

articles.body: Avatar: The Last Airbender has more than its fair share of heartfelt moments and poignant lines. Whether it’s Aang reassuring a downtrodden Toph in the vast loneliness of the desert, or Ursa’s parting words to her son Zuko before disappearing in the middle of the night, the series can be surprisingly deep for what some might (incorrectly) consider a mere children’s show. articles.body: 6 Min Read Happy 65 Years: NASA’s Johnson Space Center Then and Now View of the Manned Spacecraft Center during construction in 1963. Sixty-five years ago, a bold vision took root in Houston: a NASA center dedicated to human spaceflight. Since its founding, NASA’s Johnson Space Center has helped lead the nation’s human spaceflight program, supporting missions from Project Mercury through Artemis. Today, Johnson serves as NASA’s Center of Excellence for Human Spaceflight, and its workforce is helping to usher in a Golden Age of innovation and discovery. Johnson is home to America’s astronaut corps, the Mission Control Center, and the teams behind some of humanity’s greatest achievements in space.

articles.body: "Star Trek" celebrated its diamond anniversary last month, marking 60 years since it first aired on NBC on Sept. 8, 1966. There were a bunch of Trekkie-themed celebrations and news stories over September, including festive documentaries , special screenings , tributes, parade floats , interviews, and even a Galileo shuttle story. Now, publishers Penguin Random House and Ten Speed Press are releasing " Star Trek: The Original Voyages: A Visual History " on Nov. 10, 2026. This coffee table book promises unprecedented exploration of the pioneering space fantasy television series and enduring pop culture property that bolstered the space race and ignited sci-fi audiences' imaginations by taking us to strange new worlds and civilizations in the final frontier.
